addresses.title: Delivery addresses

security.title: Account

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Customize your notifications and customer preferences.

orders.title: Orders
orders.emptyDescription: Your order history can be displayed here.

orders.title: My orders

orders.emptyDescription: You have not placed any orders yet.
orders.errorDescription: Please try again in a few moments.

AVAILABILITY.label: New availability rule
AVAILABILITY.description: Defines when this rule makes a product, format or choice available.

VISIBILITY.label: New visibility rule
VISIBILITY.description: Defines when a choice should be visible or hidden.

SELECTION_RULE.label: New selection rule
SELECTION_RULE.description: Defines whether a choice becomes required or optional.

INCLUDED_OPTION.label: New included option
INCLUDED_OPTION.description: Defines how many options are included in a menu or format.

PRICE_RULE.label: New price rule
PRICE_RULE.description: Defines a price change, promotion or surcharge.

identity.internalDescriptionPlaceholder: Explain when and why this rule is used.

organization.favoriteHelp: The rule will appear in favorites for quick access.
organization.customerVisibleHelp: Show a title or explanation to customers when needed.
organization.customerDescriptionPlaceholder: Example: Offer valid with a student card.

adminProductWizard.title: Create a product easily
adminProductWizard.subtitle: Configure the product the way a restaurant owner thinks: formats, customer choices, paid options, format rules, included options and final preview.

intro.title: Add “{{name}}” to the product
intro.description: This choice comes from the library. Here, you only configure how it applies to this product.

validation.requiredMin: This choice is required: the minimum cannot be lower than 1.
validation.requiredMax: This choice is required: the maximum cannot be lower than 1.
validation.minGreaterThanMax: The minimum cannot be greater than the maximum.
validation.maxGreaterThanAvailableOptions: The maximum cannot exceed the number of available options.
validation.requiredChoiceWithoutVisibleOptions: This choice is required but has no visible option.

preview.title: Available options
preview.emptyOptions: No option is available in this choice.

general.title: General information
general.help: Start with the information visible on the customer menu.
general.shortDescriptionPlaceholder: E.g. Custom tacos with meat, sauces and extras.
general.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the product as it will be shown to the customer.
general.tip: Tip: use simple words. The customer should quickly understand what they are ordering.

pricing.title: Price and promotion
pricing.help: The final price will be calculated based on the selected format and options.
pricing.tip: The crossed-out price is only used to display a promotion. It does not change the final price calculation.

formats.title: Formats / sizes
formats.help: Example: Regular, Maxi, Menu, Small, Medium, Large.
formats.tip: If the product has only one format, simply keep the Standard format with an extra charge of CHF 0.

category.label: Categories
category.noneSelectedHelp: Choose or create one or more categories for this product.

categoryPicker.title: Product categories
categoryPicker.heading: Choose categories
categoryPicker.description: Select one or more existing categories or create a new one.
categoryPicker.emptyText: You can create a new category using the form below.
categoryPicker.newCategoryHelp: It will be created and added to the selection.

choices.title: Choices offered to the customer
choices.help: Examples: sauces, drinks, extras, cooking level, sides.
choices.emptyText: Add for example Sauces, Extras or Drinks.

library.title: Reusable choices
library.description: Select an existing choice such as Sauces, Drinks or Extras, then configure how it applies to this product.
library.searchPlaceholder: Search for a choice or an option
library.notFoundText: Create a custom choice for this product.
library.libraryChoiceInfo: This choice comes from the library. The rules above apply only to this product. To edit the options without impacting other products, duplicate this choice.

choices.commonHelp: Add here the choices available in every format, for example sauces, extras or cooking options.

formatRules.title: Rules by format
formatRules.help: Adapt choices based on the format: Regular, Maxi, Menu, etc.
formatRules.emptyText: First add a customer choice in the previous step.
formatRules.tip: Click a cell to customize a choice rule for a specific format. Example: Maxi allows 4 sauces instead of 2.

included.title: Included options / menus
included.help: Configure the choices included for free in certain formats.
included.emptyText: First add customer choices to define included options.

conditions.title: Special conditions
conditions.help: Add simple automations without mentioning the Rule Engine.
conditions.emptyText: Add for example a lunch menu, an included drink or an automatic surcharge.
conditions.businessHelp: Add menu exceptions: time slots, special days, free options, display by format, promotion, or automatic surcharge.
conditions.introText: The product, formats, and fixed options are already configured in the previous steps. Use this page only for special cases.
conditions.ruleNamePlaceholder: E.g. Lunch menu, Included drink, Evening surcharge

availability.title: Make available at certain times
availability.help: Limit a product, format, or choice to certain days or time slots.
availability.example: E.g. lunch menu available from 11am to 2pm

included.title: Include an option for free
included.help: Include one or more options for free in a menu or format.

visibility.title: Hide a choice by format
visibility.help: Show or hide a choice depending on the selected format.
visibility.example: E.g. drinks visible only in Menu

price.title: Add a promotion or surcharge
price.help: Automatically apply a discount or surcharge based on time, day, format, or order type.

selection.title: Make a choice required
selection.help: Make a choice required or change min/max selections.
selection.example: E.g. 2 sauces required in the evening

sectionHelp.organization: Choose whether this rule stays local to the product or can be reused from the library.
sectionHelp.availabilityConcerned: Choose what should become available or unavailable.
sectionHelp.visibilityConcerned: Choose the customer choice to show or hide, then the format if needed.
sectionHelp.includedConcerned: Choose the format or menu, then the choice to include for free.
sectionHelp.priceConcerned: Choose where to apply the surcharge or price adjustment.
sectionHelp.selectionConcerned: Choose the concerned customer choice and, if needed, the format.
sectionHelp.timing: Leave empty if this rule applies all the time.
sectionHelp.availabilityResult: Decide whether the item will be available or unavailable in this context.
sectionHelp.visibilityResult: Decide whether the choice should be shown or hidden.
sectionHelp.selectionResult: Decide whether the choice becomes required and how many options the customer can choose.
sectionHelp.includedResult: Set how many options are included for free.
sectionHelp.priceResult: Set a discount or surcharge applied automatically. Example: -2 for happy hour, +1 for an evening surcharge.

organization.saveToLibraryHelp: The rule can be reused later on other products.
organization.favoriteHelp: The rule will appear in favorites for quick access.
organization.customerVisibleHelp: Show a title or explanation to customers when needed.
organization.customerDescriptionPlaceholder: Example: Offer valid with a student card.

conditions.simpleCasesTitle: What would you like to add?
conditions.simpleCasesHelp: Choose a simple case. The system will then show only the useful fields.
conditions.advancedHelp: For a specific case that does not match the 4 shortcuts.
conditions.advancedWarning: Use only if the shortcuts are not enough. For fixed format rules, use the Format configuration step instead.
conditions.advancedTypeLabel: What do you want to create?

resultHelp.available: The customer will be able to order this item during the selected period.
resultHelp.unavailable: The customer will not be able to order this item during the selected period.
resultHelp.visible: This choice will be shown to the customer in this context.
resultHelp.hidden: This choice will be hidden from the customer in this context.

summary.includedOption: {{count}} option(s) from {{target}} will be included for free {{timing}}.
summary.priceAdjustment: {{target}} will have a {{amount}} CHF discount or surcharge {{timing}}.

conditions.advancedBuilderText: Create a custom rule, then choose its main action in the card that opens.

preview.title: Preview and publication
preview.help: Check the product as the customer will see it before publishing.

formatConfiguration.title: Format configuration
formatConfiguration.help: Define the available, required and included choices for each format.
formatConfiguration.noFormatText: Add at least one format first.
formatConfiguration.addChoiceToFormat: Add a choice to this format
formatConfiguration.emptyChoicesText: Add a common choice or a choice specific to this format.
formatConfiguration.tip: Example: for a Menu, add Drinks and Sides with 1 choice included for free.
